Symptoms.

Generalities.

Painful    Sensitiveness    of   the

Symptoms.

Generalities*

Worse  when  rising

in  a  warm  room

Better  in  the  open  air  (nervous  symp-

when  sitting  still.  (Rheumatic  and

•Hind  and  Disposition.

eyes.

with  bleeding  at  the  nose

when  rising

Sensation  of  fullness,  &  heavi-

out.

Stinging  in  the  head


Beating  in  the  head.


in  the  left  side  of  the  forehead

Crampy  sensation  in  the  fore-
head over  the  root  of  the  nose  ;  feels

Burning  head-ache  as  if  the
brain  was  moved  by  boiling  water.

Sensation  as  if  a  ball  was  rising  into
the  head  from  the  region  of  the  navel.

Eyes.

Pupils  dilated

Aversion  to  light  (Photophobia).
